findings.evidenceJa: セイバー本人が頑なに拒む
findings.governingReading: Shirou expects Saber herself to refuse stubbornly.
findings.explanation: Surely preserves confidence but omits the obstinate firmness that defines Saber’s agency here.

findings.governingReading: Illya notices Shirou looking glum or downcast.
findings.explanation: Serious replaces visible dejection with a broader neutral expression.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが消えかけてる
findings.governingReading: Illya states that Saber is already in the process of disappearing.
findings.explanation: Going to disappear removes the ongoing deterioration that Illya claims to know about.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s field of vision cuts out abruptly.
findings.explanation: Fades makes the loss gradual and softens the severing motif repeated when consciousness cuts out.

findings.evidenceJa: ようやく、意識もブツリと途切れてくれた
findings.governingReading: At last, while he cannot tell whether he lives or has died, Shirou’s consciousness mercifully snaps off as well.
findings.explanation: Fades away omits the abrupt snapping sound and the relief carried by ようやく and くれた.

findings.governingReading: Rider stabbed and slashed Shirou repeatedly.
findings.explanation: Beating replaces the weapon injuries with blunt assault and breaks the connection to his body being cut all over.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s whole body trembles under the conviction that he must win.
findings.explanation: Demanding personifies the body as issuing the imperative rather than physically manifesting his desperation.

findings.governingReading: The carpet has such a deep, long pile that one might sink into it up to the ankles.
findings.explanation: Long carpet describes its overall dimensions instead of the length of its fibers.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s consciousness begins to fade again.
findings.explanation: A mind cannot idiomatically fall unconscious, producing a malformed English description.

findings.highlight: it seems I could at least raise my arm
findings.evidenceJa: さっきみたいに指先すら動かない
findings.governingReading: Although his body is heavy, Shirou is no longer unable to move even a fingertip as he was before; with effort, he may be able to raise one arm.
findings.explanation: The English omits the recovery contrast with his earlier total paralysis.

findings.highlight: I can’t trouble her by letting her know I’ve been kidnapped.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が攫われたなんて、そんな事で負担をかける訳にはいかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou refuses to burden weakened Saber with the fact and consequences of his abduction.
findings.explanation: Letting her know invents disclosure as the source of the burden, rather than the kidnapping and rescue pressure themselves.

findings.highlight: talking to me in that park the other day
findings.evidenceJa: 公園で俺と話していた
findings.governingReading: The familiar Illya is the white girl who spoke with Shirou in the park earlier that same day.
findings.explanation: The other day displaces the encounter into an earlier date and breaks the morning-to-night timeline.

findings.governingReading: Shirou believes that if he resists or defies Illya, all of her purity may turn into hatred.
findings.explanation: Betray recasts refusal of captivity as a breach of loyalty, morally weighting the choice in Illya’s favor.

findings.highlight: asking me if I want to live or die
findings.evidenceJa: 死ぬか生きるかを問う審問に等しい
findings.governingReading: Illya’s proposal is equivalent to an inquisition deciding whether Shirou lives or dies.
findings.explanation: Asking what he wants removes the judicial coercion and makes the forced life-or-death choice sound voluntary.

findings.governingReading: Illya asserts that Saber is no longer present.
findings.explanation: Already is placed unidiomatically and muddles the state Illya treats as settled.

findings.evidenceJa: 拒否を許さない妖艶さで
findings.governingReading: Illya delivers the order with a bewitching, sensual allure that permits no refusal.
findings.explanation: The English retains the refusal pressure only as an as-if qualification and omits the disquieting allure attached to her delivery.
